entities.summary: Henri Guissou was a Burkinabé politician and diplomat. He served in numerous diplomatic roles, including as a member of the National Assembly of France and the French Senate. In 1955 he helped found the Social Party for the Emancipation of the African Masses (PSEMA), which became the Unified Democratic Party. Afterward, he represented the Republic of Upper Volta at the United Nations, to France, and to West Germany.
